open_points.subject: ArtifactPointer meaning
open_points.text: “a reference to a document a service holds about a project” conflicts with R0-60: “a pointer whose document was deleted or moved stays as it is”
open_points.question: Does an ArtifactPointer assert that its owner service currently holds the document, that it held it when the link was made, or only identify the service and reference without asserting existence?
options: It asserts current existence and custody
It asserts existence and custody only when linked
It identifies the expected holder and reference but makes no existence assertion
open_points.default_guess: It identifies the expected holder and reference but makes no existence assertion.

open_points.subject: ArtifactPointer digest attribution on import
open_points.text: “its content digest when its publisher gave one” and “The digest is its publisher's claim” conflict with “Its publisher is therefore the import itself — the migration closure (M10), not a principal” for imported pointers whose digest came from the v1 source
open_points.question: Whose claim is the digest of an imported pointer: the unidentified legacy writer's, the migration/import's, or an unattributed value preserved from the source?
options: An unattributed source value preserved verbatim
open_points.default_guess: An unattributed source value preserved verbatim.
